Salla's checkout page and cart, coarser than Shopify's split: its dashboard link Checkout at /checkout, its settings Guest checkout, its flags store-checkout and guest-checkout, and its Checkout APIs collection, whose folders Cart and Cart Items are cited in the child CM-CHK-002, in this tree. Shopify's checkout and accounts editor at settings/checkout/editor (SH-S-5103), its Checkout branding and Checkout and accounts configurations APIs with their scopes, and its plan row Checkout customization, Limited on Basic, Grow and Advanced, Full on Plus (SH-S-7053). Its statement on Participating Channels customizing Shopify Checkout (SH-S-0628) is cited as extension-point in domain F's CM-AIA-005 (under SH-C-140) and only as shows here.

Shopify's Cart and Checkout Validation Function API (SH-S-0853), its function target cart_checkout_validation, its settings extension validation_settings_ui and its scopes read_validations and write_validations. Shopify's Cart Transform Function API (SH-S-0854, SH-S-2225), its scopes read_cart_transforms and write_cart_transforms, and the mutation's requirement that the store has upgraded to Checkout Extensibility (SH-S-6171).
